text: Now it is your turn. Have fun!
Welcome to ARAW! Here is the app in one minute.
First, pick your language. You can change it later in Me.
Press Start when the sun has risen.
Home shows your next lesson, the daily challenge and the myth of the day.
Learn has ten short modules. Go step by step, starting with Module 1.
Each module has short cards, quick questions and a game. Ara helps you along.
The Arcade has quick games to practise what you learned.
The Library has myths and facts, a glossary, comics and these videos.
In Me, see your badges and turn on helpers like Larger text.
See something wrong? Press the flag to tell us.
Learn when to trust AI and health info. Let us begin!
ARAW comes from AIKasalig, the project "Advancing Responsible AI in Philippine Healthcare: A Multi-Year NLP-Driven Roadmap for Trust, Transparency, and Ethical AI".

Its goal is an AI Trust Toolkit, multilingual and informed by communities. The toolkit uses natural language processing (NLP) in five languages (Filipino, Cebuano, Ilocano, Hiligaynon and English) to bring out what people say about AI in health care: signs of trust, feelings, and health misinformation.

The project's outputs include annotated text collections, classifiers, dashboards, an AI Trust Index, and AI literacy modules for health workers and communities. The work is aligned with the digital health priorities of DOST-PCHRD.

ARAW carries the project's AI literacy modules: short lessons and games that teach calibrated trust in AI and health information, in the same five languages as the project. It is made for community members and health workers, including people who are new to AI.
In community workshops, facilitators give the two matched Fact or Fake tests before and after the lessons, to see how much people's skills grew.
Mico C. Magtira, Senior Data and NLP-Geospatial Scientist, DOST-NICER
DOST-NICER R&D Center on Natural Language Processing for Health Applications (RDC-NLPHA)
ARAW is the hands-on AI literacy app of AIKasalig, a project on responsible AI in Philippine health care.

AIKasalig is Project 4 of the program Research and Development Center on Natural Language Processing for Health Applications (RDC-NLPHA). The program is part of DOST's NICER (Niche Centers in the Regions for R&D) and is implemented by National University, Manila.
AdvocAid PH: geospatial AI for HIV public health surveillance
Bantay Lamok PH: mosquito density and outbreak prediction
TALA: a learning module on text and location analytics, also from AIKasalig
